Phase 1 · Foundation
tenant, management, hub, sub-aks-dev
address plan reserved from corporate IPAM
Azure Policy: all assignments in audit

div.style: color: rgb(230, 237, 243) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Phase 2 · Rapid prototyping
build → test → change, in days not weeks
until every requirement R1–R20 has a passing test

policies switched to deny
performance · HA / chaos · zero-downtime upgrades
rebuild & recovery · operations
